description: This Java class 'SelfSavingsDataValidator' provides validation methods for handling self-savings data API requests within the Apache Fineract project. It validates query parameters for retrieving savings and savings transactions, and also validates JSON input for savings application requests.

classes.name: SelfSavingsDataValidator
classes.description: A validator component for self-savings related API requests, ensuring correct query parameters and JSON payloads.

methods.name: validateRetrieveSavings
methods.description: Validates query parameters for retrieving savings, checking unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateRetrieveSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Validates query parameters for retrieving savings transactions.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfReqd
methods.description: Throws exception if there are unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Checks if the request uses templates and flags if unsupported.

methods.name: validateSavingsApplication
methods.description: Validates JSON input for savings application, ensuring required fields are present and correctly formatted.
